title: Consistency-Preserving Concept Erasure via Unsafe–Safe Pairing and Directional Fisher-weighted Adaptation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method (PAIR) for erasing specific visual concepts such as nudity, artistic styles, and objects from text-to-image diffusion models. Although it utilizes a Multimodal Large Language Model (GPT-5.2) as a judge and discusses unlearning safety for 'harmful content,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical systems.
